description: Scanning and ringing up items on the POS app; card, PIN debit, and SNAP EBT payments on the countertop terminal; cash; receipts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $580 in sales per open day, about 80% of it by card or EBT; SNAP households in the neighborhood cannot buy food here without the terminal; RPO set by the POS app vendor's sync of sales totals
manual_workaround: Cash only with a paper tally and a printed price list; hand-written receipts; send card and EBT customers to the nearest store that takes them; never write down card numbers
dependent_third_parties: Payment processor; POS app vendor; internet service provider; state EBT network (through the processor)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner and family member at the register; storefront

business_process: Online and phone orders, pickup and delivery
description: Receiving online and phone orders; taking payment (hosted payment page or terminal); packing; pickup and delivery within about 2 miles
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 13 orders a week (about $450); regular phone-order customers include older neighbors who rely on delivery; card data handling is the main regulatory exposure
manual_workaround: Take orders by phone and key card details into the terminal while the customer is on the line; customers pay at pickup; post a notice on the store door and website
dependent_third_parties: Website builder vendor; payment processor; phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (only driver and only person who packs orders)

description: Weekly ordering from the wholesale distributor's portal; receiving Tuesday and Friday deliveries; updating prices in the POS app
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A missed order cutoff empties the produce, dairy, and meat shelves until the next delivery day; perishables drive the safety rating (spoiled stock must be pulled)
manual_workaround: Phone the distributor's sales representative; buy urgent items at a cash-and-carry warehouse; price new items from the paper invoice
dependent_third_parties: Wholesale grocery distributor; POS app vendor

description: Daily deposits from the processor; supplier payments; accounting SaaS; monthly sales tax return; quarterly estimated tax; Schedule C at year end
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines are monthly and quarterly; processor deposits continue without the owner; personal savings cover about one month of expenses
manual_workaround: Use the bank's and processor's portals directly; keep paper copies of the last sales tax return
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; bank; payment processor; tax preparer

description: Online store updates; order confirmations; texts with phone-order customers; weekly offer emails and price changes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Promotions can pause for days; an inaccurate offer or price claim is the larger risk (FTC Act Section 5; P10)
manual_workaround: Sign on the store door; phone regular customers; pause offer emails
dependent_third_parties: Website builder vendor; email provider; AI chatbot vendor
